The change in exception handling improves the robustness of the IPC client by ensuring that it no longer indiscriminately downgrades all exceptions to `IOException`, thus preserving the original exception types when applicable. This relationship highlights the connection between the code change and the documented bug fix, providing clarity on the purpose and impact of the modification.
